name: Cairn: Warden's Guide — Spellbooks

usage_note: A spellbook is a magical Relic that lets its bearer cast a single specific spell. Roll 1d100 (2d10: one for the tens place, one for the ones place) to determine a spellbook at random, or choose one deliberately. Each spellbook also has a mundane, everyday effect (mundane_effect) that manifests even when its owner isn't actively casting the spell.

entries.name: Adhere
entries.effect: An object is covered in extremely sticky slime.
entries.mundane_effect: Adjacent objects stick to the book with great force.

entries.name: Anchor
entries.effect: A strong wire sprouts from your arms, affixing itself to two points within 50ft on each side.
entries.mundane_effect: If a rope is pulled through the iron loop on its spine, it becomes as heavy as an elephant.

entries.name: Animate Object
entries.effect: An object obeys your commands as best it can.
entries.mundane_effect: Moldable like clay. Childish laughter sprouts from its pages.

entries.name: Anthropomorphize
entries.effect: An animal either gains human intelligence or human appearance for one day.
entries.mundane_effect: Whimpers, purrs and growls depending on its treatment.

entries.name: Arcane Eye
entries.effect: You can see through a magical floating eyeball that flies around at your command.
entries.mundane_effect: Needs a spritz of water to open.

entries.name: Astral Prison
entries.effect: An object is frozen in time and space within an invulnerable crystal shell.
entries.mundane_effect: Silent, abstract, faces scream in anguish within.

entries.name: Attract
entries.effect: Two objects are strongly magnetically attracted to each other if they come within 10 feet.
entries.mundane_effect: Nearby compasses spin uselessly.

entries.name: Auditory Illusion
entries.effect: You create illusory sounds that seem to come from a direction of your choice.
entries.mundane_effect: Produces random and occasionally inopportune sounds throughout the day.

entries.name: Babble
entries.effect: A creature must loudly and clearly repeat everything you think. It is otherwise mute.
entries.mundane_effect: When the text is read aloud, the words of others become unintelligible.

entries.name: Bait Flower
entries.effect: A plant sprouts from the ground that emanates the smell of decaying flesh.
entries.mundane_effect: Attracts flies.

entries.name: Beast Form
entries.effect: You and your possessions transform into a mundane animal.
entries.mundane_effect: Covered in thick fur, its edges lined with small teeth.

entries.name: Befuddle
entries.effect: A creature of your choice is unable to form new short-term memories for the duration of the spell.
entries.mundane_effect: Its contents shift and change each time it is opened.

entries.name: Body Swap
entries.effect: You switch bodies with a creature you touch. If one body dies, the other dies as well.
entries.mundane_effect: The front cover shows an image of the last creature to read it.

entries.name: Charm
entries.effect: A creature you can see treats you as a friend.
entries.mundane_effect: Warm to the touch, and smells of roses.

entries.name: Command
entries.effect: A target obeys a single three-word command that does not cause it harm.
entries.mundane_effect: Grows thinner over time, until finally disappearing forever.

entries.name: Comprehend
entries.effect: You become fluent in all languages for a short while.
entries.mundane_effect: Drips letters, staining whatever it touches.

entries.name: Cone of Foam
entries.effect: Dense foam sprays from your hand, coating the target.
entries.mundane_effect: Spongy and moist with a soapy residue.

entries.name: Control Plants
entries.effect: Nearby plants and trees obey you and gain the ability to move at a slow pace.
entries.mundane_effect: Leaves grow along the spine, and it smells faintly of decay.

entries.name: Control Weather
entries.effect: You may alter the type of weather at will, but you do not otherwise control it.
entries.mundane_effect: Highly resistant to fire and water damage.

entries.name: Cure Wounds
entries.effect: Restore 1d4 STR per day to a creature you can touch.
entries.mundane_effect: Smells of vinegar and thyme. Turns red after use.

entries.name: Deafen
entries.effect: All nearby creatures are deafened.
entries.mundane_effect: Nearby instruments occasionally sound off, as if in protest.

entries.name: Detect Magic
entries.effect: You can see or hear nearby magical auras.
entries.mundane_effect: Becomes warm to the touch if magic is used nearby.

entries.name: Disassemble
entries.effect: Any of your body parts may be detached and reattached at will, without causing pain or damage. You can still control them.
entries.mundane_effect: Regenerates any torn or defaced pages.

entries.name: Disguise
entries.effect: You may alter the appearance of one character at will as long as they remain humanoid. Attempts to duplicate other characters will seem uncanny.
entries.mundane_effect: The surface makes a perfect mirror.

entries.name: Displace
entries.effect: An object appears to be up to 15ft from its actual position.
entries.mundane_effect: Bits of string, clothing, and leaves are sometimes stuffed inside.

entries.name: Earthquake
entries.effect: The ground begins shaking violently. Structures may be damaged or collapse.
entries.mundane_effect: Sand dribbles from the corners, seemingly without stop.

entries.name: Elasticity
entries.effect: Your body can stretch up to 10ft.
entries.mundane_effect: Smells of taffy, and is very flexible.

entries.name: Elemental Wall
entries.effect: A straight wall of ice or fire 50ft long and 10ft high rises from the ground.
entries.mundane_effect: Skin and warmer substances stick to it after use.

entries.name: Filch
entries.effect: A visible item teleports to your hands.
entries.mundane_effect: An ally's prized possession may occasionally be found tucked between its covers.

entries.name: Fish Lung
entries.effect: A target can breathe underwater until they surface again.
entries.mundane_effect: Smells strongly of the sea. Attracts wild animals.

entries.name: Flare
entries.effect: A bright ball of energy fires a trail of light into the sky, revealing your location to friend or foe.
entries.mundane_effect: Faintly glows in complete darkness.

entries.name: Fog Cloud
entries.effect: A dense fog spreads out from you.
entries.mundane_effect: When submersed in water, the book eventually turns all the liquid to vapor.

entries.name: Frenzy
entries.effect: A nearby creature erupts in a frenzy of violence.
entries.mundane_effect: Rough, sandpaper cover that destroys any book it touches.

entries.name: Gate
entries.effect: A portal to a random plane opens.
entries.mundane_effect: A large hole is carved into the center, ending in a void. Items dropped within are never seen again.

entries.name: Gravity Shift
entries.effect: You can change the direction of gravity, but only for yourself.
entries.mundane_effect: Attaches itself to the largest object nearby.

entries.name: Greed
entries.effect: A creature develops the overwhelming urge to possess a visible item of your choice.
entries.mundane_effect: The cover changes depending on the owner, subtly hinting at their deepest desires.

entries.name: Haste
entries.effect: Your movement speed is tripled.
entries.mundane_effect: Pages flip wildly while open. Can cause paper cuts.

entries.name: Hatred
entries.effect: A creature develops a deep hatred of another creature or group and wishes to destroy them.
entries.mundane_effect: Long term exposure to the book can cause suspicion, paranoia and distrust of others.

entries.name: Hear Whispers
entries.effect: You can hear faint sounds clearly.
entries.mundane_effect: The reader's voice is amplified for a short period of time afterwards.

entries.name: Hover
entries.effect: An object hovers, frictionless, 2ft above the ground. It can hold up to one humanoid.
entries.mundane_effect: Floats if dropped.

entries.name: Hypnotize
entries.effect: A creature enters a trance and will truthfully answer one yes or no question you ask it.
entries.mundane_effect: Eye-catching, swirling spirals don its covers.

entries.name: Icy Touch
entries.effect: A thick ice layer spreads across a touched surface, up to 10ft in radius.
entries.mundane_effect: Gloves required. Nonflammable.

entries.name: Identify Owner
entries.effect: Letters appear over the object you touch, spelling out the name of the object's owners, if there are any.
entries.mundane_effect: The book's interior lists the name of its previous owner.

entries.name: Illuminate
entries.effect: A floating light moves as you command.
entries.mundane_effect: When held in light, the pages become a prism of vibrant rainbows.

entries.name: Invisible Tether
entries.effect: Two objects within 10ft of each other cannot be moved more than 10ft apart.
entries.mundane_effect: Its pages are not attached by glue or thread, yet stay together nonetheless.

entries.name: Knock
entries.effect: A nearby mundane or magical lock unlocks loudly.
entries.mundane_effect: Locked. A new owner "produces" the key after their next meal.

entries.name: Leap
entries.effect: You jump up to 10ft high, once.
entries.mundane_effect: When thrown, it just keeps going.

entries.name: Liquid Air
entries.effect: The air around you becomes swimmable.
entries.mundane_effect: Floats of its own volition, bouncing off of whatever it touches.

entries.name: Magic Dampener
entries.effect: All nearby magical effects have their effectiveness halved.
entries.mundane_effect: Relics within 100ft of the spellbook cannot be recharged.

entries.name: Manse
entries.effect: A sturdy, furnished cottage appears for hours. You can permit and forbid entry to it at will.
entries.mundane_effect: If left inside, both the book and the cottage vanish forever.

entries.name: Marble Craze
entries.effect: Your pockets are full of marbles and will refill every 30 seconds.
entries.mundane_effect: When jostled, makes a playful rattling sound.

entries.name: Masquerade
entries.effect: A character's appearance and voice becomes identical to those of a character you touch.
entries.mundane_effect: Extended use causes the owner to develop unconscious yet noticeable tics.

entries.name: Miniaturize
entries.effect: A creature you touch is shrunk down to the size of a mouse.
entries.mundane_effect: The text is ludicrously, comically large.

entries.name: Mirror Image
entries.effect: An illusory duplicate of yourself appears and is under your control.
entries.mundane_effect: Over time, the owner begins to question who is the original, and who is the duplicate.

entries.name: Mirrorwalk
entries.effect: A mirror becomes a gateway to another mirror that you looked into today.
entries.mundane_effect: Will not open unless the owner politely knocks on the cover.

entries.name: Multiarm
entries.effect: You temporarily gain an extra arm.
entries.mundane_effect: After use, the caster is wracked with phantom limb syndrome for a day.

entries.name: Night Sphere
entries.effect: A 50ft-wide sphere of darkness displaying the night sky appears before you.
entries.mundane_effect: Displays a prominent constellation on its cover.

entries.name: Objectify
entries.effect: You become any inanimate object between the size of a grand piano and an apple.
entries.mundane_effect: The owner experiences intense pareidolia for days after use.

entries.name: Ooze Form
entries.effect: You become a living jelly.
entries.mundane_effect: Slowly drips an acid that eventually eats away anything it touches.

entries.name: Pacify
entries.effect: A creature near you has an aversion to violence.
entries.mundane_effect: Smells of jasmine and incense. Attracts children.

entries.name: Passage
entries.effect: Creates a temporary path through wood, stone or brick.
entries.mundane_effect: An object dropped on top of the book inevitably falls through the other side.

entries.name: Phobia
entries.effect: A nearby creature becomes terrified of an object of your choice.
entries.mundane_effect: Over time, haunting, abstract art begins to fill its pages.

entries.name: Pit
entries.effect: A pit 10ft wide and 10ft deep opens in the ground.
entries.mundane_effect: A standard piton can be safely stored in its spine.

entries.name: Primal Surge
entries.effect: A creature rapidly evolves into a future version of its species.
entries.mundane_effect: The owner is haunted by strange visions of their own ancestors.

entries.name: Push/Pull
entries.effect: An object of any size is pulled directly towards you or pushed directly away from you with the strength of one man.
entries.mundane_effect: Any force against the book is comically amplified.

entries.name: Raise Dead
entries.effect: A skeleton rises from the ground to serve you. They are incredibly stupid and can only obey simple orders.
entries.mundane_effect: The owner becomes more and more fascinated with bones after each use.

entries.name: Raise Spirit
entries.effect: The spirit of a nearby corpse manifests and will answer 1 question.
entries.mundane_effect: The answers (but not their questions) are forever inscribed in its pages.

entries.name: Read Mind
entries.effect: You can hear the surface thoughts of nearby creatures.
entries.mundane_effect: Long-term possession can cause the reader to mistake the thoughts of others as their own.

entries.name: Repel
entries.effect: Two objects are strongly magnetically repelled from each other within 10 feet.
entries.mundane_effect: Closed by two powerful straps that spring open at inopportune times.

entries.name: Scry
entries.effect: You can see through the eyes of a creature you touched earlier today.
entries.mundane_effect: The owner's eyes turn milky-white for an hour after use.

entries.name: Sculpt Elements
entries.effect: Inanimate material behaves like clay in your hands.
entries.mundane_effect: Slowly decays on contact with wood or cloth. Bury in dirt or submerge in water to refresh.

entries.name: Sense
entries.effect: Choose one kind of object (key, gold, arrow, jug, etc). You can sense the nearest example.
entries.mundane_effect: The book's previous owner is always aware of the book's current location.

entries.name: Shield
entries.effect: A creature you touch is protected from mundane attacks for one minute.
entries.mundane_effect: Bound in rusty ring-mail and is quite heavy. If held, provides +1 Armor.

entries.name: Shroud
entries.effect: A creature you touch is invisible until they move.
entries.mundane_effect: Invisible to any but the book's current owner.

entries.name: Shuffle
entries.effect: Two creatures you can see instantly switch places.
entries.mundane_effect: If stolen but not yet read, it reappears wherever its owner last left it.

entries.name: Skillful Repair
entries.effect: You make minor repairs to a nonliving object.
entries.mundane_effect: Sewn from the vellum of one hundred books, no two pages are alike.

entries.name: Sleep
entries.effect: A creature you can see falls into a light sleep.
entries.mundane_effect: Soft as a pillow, but yields only fitful sleep.

entries.name: Slick
entries.effect: Every surface in a 30ft radius becomes extremely slippery.
entries.mundane_effect: Gloves are required for handling, lest the book is dropped in a most comical fashion.

entries.name: Smoke Form
entries.effect: Your body becomes a living smoke that you can control.
entries.mundane_effect: Smells of campfire. The pages cannot be burnt, but are very sensitive to moisture.

entries.name: Sniff
entries.effect: You can smell even the faintest traces of scents.
entries.mundane_effect: Expresses a strong odor detectable only by its owner.

entries.name: Snuff
entries.effect: The source of any mundane light you can see is instantly snuffed out.
entries.mundane_effect: If left in one place for long periods, nearby light sources eventually dim, then finally go out.

entries.name: Sort
entries.effect: Inanimate items sort themselves according to categories you set.
entries.mundane_effect: Rights itself when dropped or thrown.

entries.name: Spellsaw
entries.effect: A whirling blade flies from your chest, clearing any plant material in its way. It is otherwise harmless.
entries.mundane_effect: Wrapped in stained leather, it should be oiled at least once a month.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries.effect: You can climb surfaces like a spider.
entries.mundane_effect: New cobwebs must be pushed aside prior to each use. They are hard to remove.

entries.name: Swarm
entries.effect: You become a swarm of crows, rats, or piranhas. You can only be harmed by _blast_ attacks.
entries.mundane_effect: Easily broken into a dozen distinct parts that slowly move towards one another over time.

entries.name: Target Lure
entries.effect: An object you touch becomes the target of any nearby spell.
entries.mundane_effect: Attracts all manner of magical creatures, spell leaks, and scrying.

entries.name: Telekinesis
entries.effect: You may mentally move 1 item under 60lbs.
entries.mundane_effect: The owner can summon the book through mental command alone (WIL save or become deprived afterwards).

entries.name: Telepathy
entries.effect: Two creatures can hear each other's thoughts, no matter how far apart.
entries.mundane_effect: The holder can hear (but not respond) to the thoughts of whoever last possessed it, and vice versa.

entries.name: Teleport
entries.effect: An object or person you can see is transported from one place to another in a 50ft radius.
entries.mundane_effect: Can be destroyed to create a portal to another dimension.

entries.name: Thicket
entries.effect: A thicket of trees and dense brush up to 50ft wide suddenly sprouts up.
entries.mundane_effect: Wrapped in vines that must be destroyed again with each use.

entries.name: Time Control
entries.effect: Time in a 50ft bubble slows down or increases by 10% for 30 seconds.
entries.mundane_effect: Alternates its appearance as either impossibly old or freshly written.

entries.name: True Sight
entries.effect: You see through all nearby illusions.
entries.mundane_effect: Cannot be concealed by magic, and sticks out like a sore thumb.

entries.name: Upwell
entries.effect: A spring of seawater appears.
entries.mundane_effect: Hardened leather bindings caked in salt and living barnacles.

entries.name: Vision
entries.effect: You completely control what a creature sees.
entries.mundane_effect: An unnerving, lidless eye graces the front cover.

entries.name: Visual Illusion
entries.effect: A silent, immobile, room-sized illusion of your choice appears.
entries.mundane_effect: Filled with rich, colorful pages very much like a children's bedtime story.

entries.name: Ward
entries.effect: A silver circle 50ft across appears on the ground. Choose one species that cannot cross it.
entries.mundane_effect: The covers are decorated with bizarre, otherworldly creatures with thousands of eyes.

entries.name: Web
entries.effect: Your wrists shoot thick webbing.
entries.mundane_effect: The text is alien, yet somehow intelligible, for it is the language of dreams.

entries.name: Widget
entries.effect: A primitive version of a drawn tool or item appears before you and disappears after a short time.
entries.mundane_effect: Smells of iron and rust, sweat and effort. Faint sounds of harsh labor emanate from deep within its pages.

entries.name: Wizard Mark
entries.effect: Your finger can shoot a stream of ulfire-colored paint. This paint is only visible to you and can be seen at any distance, even through solid objects.
entries.mundane_effect: Inside the front cover is a small pocket containing a thin pad of paper, listing the name and date of death of all previous owners.

entries.name: X-Ray Vision
entries.effect: You can see through walls, dirt, clothing, etc.
entries.mundane_effect: Long-term exposure can cause hair loss, blurry vision, and fatigue.
